body:
## Summary
- add a FileTransferProductOwner no-Host regression covering incoming completion save failure cleanup
- assert both private incoming staging and app-download partial files are removed after failed save
- extend the MainActivity file-transfer boundary contract so UI completion handling keeps staging cleanup before UI result reporting

## Verification
- ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.FileTransferProductOwnerTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityFileTransferSystemBoundaryContractTest
- ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.FileTransferProductOwnerTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityFileTransferSystemBoundaryContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.AppSpecificDownloadsSaverTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ProductSessionCoordinatorTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.FileTransferSessionTest
- adb -s <redacted-adb-serial> shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer/model/device/release: nubia / P0110 / pacific / Android 16
- attempted no-Host instrumentation on <redacted-adb-serial> with FileTransferOfferDialogLayoutInstrumentedTest and ControlBarLayoutInstrumentedTest; runner crashed after partial execution, so this is not claimed as passing device evidence

## Gate note
This only strengthens no-Host precondition coverage. It does not close or claim the real Android/macOS bidirectional product file-transfer E2E gate.
title: test: harden Android file transfer cleanup recovery
